title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: refuse a $searchFields entry naming a secret / password field at the data door

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27829

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the data doors (`GET /data/:object`, `POST /data/:object/query`, and every other caller of `findData`) refuse a search-field override naming a `secret` / `password` field, which they answered 200 over the rest of the declared search set before. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches or emits a credential name in `searchFields` (`git grep -n "searchFields\|searchableFields" -- skills` at this head: no hit mentions a `secret` / `password` / credential field); the one docs page that lists the search refusals gains the row here (`content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对象的 `searchableFields` 声明了 `secret` / `password` 字段时，请求里 `$searchFields`（或 POST 的 `searchFields` / 对象形 `search.fields`）点名该字段，数据接口现在回 400 `INVALID_FIELD` 并点名字段，不再读库。
- **为什么改**：以前门放行这个名字，引擎又按凭据规则把该列从搜索里拿掉，结果悄悄搜了声明里的其余字段：只想搜 `api_key`，拿到的是按 `name` 匹配的行，看不出任何异常（不泄露凭据，但答非所问）。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响在 `$searchFields` 里点名凭据字段的调用方；Console 列表搜索会原样回传视图的 `searchableFields`，若某视图声明了凭据字段，搜索会从 200 变 400（lint 早已把这种声明报为错误）。引擎侧的凭据隐藏不动，仍是兜底。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts`（`assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable` 新增的 `credential` 一支与它的文案），`packages/rest/src/data-search-fields-credential-door.test.ts`（门级钉子）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/data-search-fields-credential-door.test.ts`，预期 6 个用例全过（secret、password 各三：GET 拒收、POST 拒收、对照组照旧）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（进队前欠一次契约复核）。

## What changes

- **`assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`** (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts`): after the allowed set is resolved, a requested name the set KEPT whose field type is a credential (`isCredentialFieldType`, `@objectstack/spec/data`, the predicate the engine's `collectCredentialFields` withhold reads) is refused `400 INVALID_FIELD` with `field`, `fields`, `object` and `param` set, in the envelope every other refusal of this gate uses. Message: `Field 'api_key' on object 'OBJ' is type 'secret', a credential, and cannot be searched. …`, the wording family the auto-default path already gives a credential name ("is type 'secret'"), plus the remedy: remove it from `searchableFields` when the object declares it, search another column. Only a declared `searchableFields` keeps a credential in the allowed set (the auto default excludes the types and still refuses them with its own message, unchanged).
- It covers the standalone slot in every spelling and the object-form `search.fields`, because `protocol.ts` hands both to this one gate (measured: the POST legs below). No line of the hot file `protocol.ts` moves.
- Order in the cascade: unknown → stale declaration → virtual → **credential** → unsearchable, so a request with a typo still gets the typo answer first.
- The engine is unchanged: its credential withhold (ADR-0100) stays as the fail-closed floor for direct engine callers.
- New door pin `rest/src/data-search-fields-credential-door.test.ts`: real `RestServer` → `findData` → `ObjectQL` → sqlite, the #27484 harness; two objects declaring `searchableFields: [name, api_key]` with `api_key` `secret` and `password`. GET `$searchFields=api_key` and `$searchFields=name,api_key`, POST `searchFields: ['api_key']` and object-form `search.fields: ['name', 'api_key']` each answer 400 `INVALID_FIELD` naming `api_key` and its type, with zero reads of the object; controls `$searchFields=name`, no `$searchFields`, and POST `searchFields: ['name']` answer 200 with the two `name` matches.
- Docs: one row in the refusal table of `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`.
- Changeset `.changeset/27829-search-fields-credential-refused.md` (`patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required`).

## Verification

Local subset, head `f6a224d1`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 90 families; every one run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all 90 `exit 0` (`check:type-check-debt` under `os-verify-lock.sh`). `--ran` reconcile: "90 derived, 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a derived zero: every entry carries its exit code). On the first pass (`1d6b7d0d`) `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, dists unbuilt); both are exit 0 here after the full package build, not read as a verdict before. CI-run families: see this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- Producer that will see the new 400: the Console's list search (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRowLoad.ts`) sends the VIEW's `searchableFields` as `$searchFields` verbatim. A view declaring a credential entry used to search the rest of its list silently; it now answers 400 naming the field. `validate-searchable-fields` (`@objectstack/lint`) already reports that declaration as an error on every surface, so the fix for the author is the one the lint names.
- The `declared` branch of the existing "not searchable" message lists the allowed set (`allowed.join(', ')`), which still names a declared credential entry. Cosmetic, not changed here.
- In-flight intersection on the hot file: at branch time the only open PR touching `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` was #27860 (head `fd02314b`); `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this branch against it was clean (exit 0), and it has since merged into `main`, which this head includes. No open PR touches the other changed files.
